name: xipfax
description: Fax any document to any fax number with XipFax: add your pages, get the fax's price, send it, and get its confirmation. It also finds IRS offices' fax numbers.

interface.shortDescription: Fax any document to any number
interface.longDescription:
Fax any document to any fax number from your chat, with no fax machine.

Send a signed lease to a landlord, a claim to an insurer, a form to a school, or papers to a lender or a court. Once you sign in to your XipFax account, XipFax puts your pages on a fax: a PDF at a public link, a PDF or a photo on your computer in Codex, or pages you add from your phone or browser on a one-time page it gives you. It sends the fax to the number you give it. Then it tells you how the fax went, and gives you a delivered fax's confirmation: one page that says who received how many pages, and when.

Faxing the IRS? XipFax finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes a form or a notice, such as Form 2848 or a CP2000, and asks where you live when the number depends on it. It tells you when an office wants a form signed by hand, in ink, and sends your fax to the office it found.

Who it's for: anyone with pages to fax and no fax machine.

Limits: XipFax faxes numbers in the United States, its territories and Canada. It doesn't fill in forms, so fill in and sign your form first. Each fax waits on XipFax for you to check and send it, unless your XipFax account is set to send straight away.
